def create(self, req, body):
        data = InstantiationData(body)

        action = self.rpc_client.node_create(req.context, data.name(),
                                             data.cluster_id(),
                                             data.profile_id(),
                                             data.role(), data.tags())
        return {'id': action['target'], 'action_id': action['id']}
